format.raw: UTF-8 tab-separated rows with one frozen header; no quoting
format.aggregate: raw per-seed files plus one zstd-compressed concatenation
format.float_format: decimal with 9 significant digits, parsed as float32
format.sequence_encoding: lower-upper pairs separated by semicolons; present only when final_count <= 45

feature_columns: f000 through f084 in features-v1 index order

instrumentation.enabled_only_by: MERICANII_DATASET_PATH absolute path plus MERICANII_DATASET_SEED matching ec.rand.seed
instrumentation.sentinel_requirement: instrumentation-off and instrumentation-on produce identical 50200 evaluations, final sequence, and final size
